headline: Introducing 15 DTC Skills for Claude, Free for Media Buyers and Creative Strategists
subhead: Five groups of DTC paid growth work: research, creative, media buying, conversion, and the money. Fifteen Claude skills, one file per skill, free to keep.
subhead_secondary: Paste the screen you already have open underneath the skill and it answers, or it names the exact field it's missing.
inside: Research: read competitor ads and customer language before you write anything
Creative: turn one angle into a brief, a hook set, a script, or the next round of tests
Media buying: tracking, account hygiene, and budget steps checked before you touch spend
Conversion: the ad's promise checked against what the page actually says
The money: break-even, affordable CPA, ROAS against MER, and a scale-or-kill call on every ad
proof: Built by the team that runs paid growth for DTC brands. RISE buys media for DTC brands and gets paid on the growth it adds. These skills are the same checks, packaged as one file each.
